rationale: Email deliverability failures for new domains are a high-frequency, revenue-blocking pain documented across dozens of forums, Reddit threads, and support communities — operators are actively losing leads and sales. Willingness-to-pay is confirmed by multiple paid competitors (MXToolbox Pro, GlockApps, Postmark) charging $10–$99/month, and by job postings for deliverability consultants. The target segment (new-domain SMB operators without in-house technical staff) is clearly defined and reachable through the communities where they already self-identify.
